topic.title: Is heliosli's R7 model, trained with fastMRI, allowed in a final submission?

comments.content:
Not staff just so we’re clear on that.

The datasets that they used you have to sign up for.

The base code used was copied & my educated assumption is that their AI remake of my work with this additional data is overfit anyways.

Personally, could’ve done the same thing two months ago but did not, the private board should shake it out of the mix.
